D2: I002 changed only gate/up to subgroup split-K; Q/K/V/O/down/LM-head remain row-owned serial-K Arc shaders.
D3: pinned llama Q4_K/Q6_K Vulkan matvec distributes K across WG threads, vectorizes input loads and reduces partials with multi-row specialization.
D4: optimistic linear compute floor ~3.54ms is far below one-pass weight floor ~32.14ms.
D5: XMX is not the pinned llama explanation because runtime reports matrix cores:none.
D6: Arc cached-GQA source may repeat KV addressing across seven Q heads/KV head; physical traffic unresolved.
D7: 447.07MB Q6 lm-head + serial-H row ownership is structurally large but not yet authorized as next intervention.
D8: 469 dispatches are topology evidence, not proof of causality; historical pre-I002 lifecycle/barrier shares were small.

conclusions: The ~10x practical gap is not explained by one residual family; multiple Arc quantized matvec families remain far above the pinned llama execution envelope.
I002 split-K moved gate/up into a materially better regime: despite ~48.9% of logical weight payload, its cross-runtime geomean excess is ~5.34x, substantially below the residual row-serial families.
FFN-down is the largest post-I002 Arc coarse cost (~35.1% ticks combined); Q4-down geomean excess ~15.89x and Q6-down ~10.02x.
LM-head has the largest single-family mean attributable practical gap (~204ms) and geomean excess ~27.56x despite only ~10.2% of logical weight payload.
Small-output K/V families show extreme time-per-weight pressure, consistent with poor work partitioning/occupancy/cache-load efficiency in the row-serial Arc mapping.
Pinned llama major quantized families sit roughly 2.2-4.6x above the optimistic 136GB/s weight-only floor; Arc ranges roughly 12.5-135x on the same family accounting.

Hardware counters are not required to choose the next causal discriminator: source topology plus same-semantic timing already discriminates row-serial K organization as a high-value mechanism hypothesis.
cross_runtime_excess_cost_map.m3_reason: Counters could refine whether the residual tax is cache, occupancy, issue utilization, or physical bandwidth, but they are not necessary before a direct causal work-partitioning intervention.

rationale: FFN-down is the largest current coarse Arc family.
Q4 down alone has ~15.89x cross-runtime geomean excess.
It uses the same Q4_K quant format as the already-proven gate/up split-K mechanism, isolating shape/work-partition transfer rather than introducing Q6 simultaneously.
Its K=18944 / rows=3584 geometry is deliberately different and harder than the prior gate/up K=3584 / rows=18944 case.
A strong sentinel transfer would causally support the row-serial-K hypothesis; a failure would justify deeper M3 counters before expanding to Q6/LM-head.

execution_occupancy.note: CS utilization aliases equal ALL utilization for every dispatch; direct occupancy counter is all-zero.

mechanism_interpretation: I002 gate/up split-K is the healthy hardware control: device-memory reads are ~1.02x logical weight payload, LSC hit ~98.3%, ALU1 utilization ~87%, and XVE stall ~6%.

Q/O row-serial-K are not primarily DRAM-bandwidth limited: device-memory reads remain ~1.08-1.15x weight and LSC hit ~98.7-99.7%, yet ALU1 utilization is only ~16% and XVE stall ~71%, dominated by SBID ~61%.

FFN-down row-serial-K combines dependency stalls with traffic amplification. Q4-down reads ~3.34x/4.40x its weight payload and has ~61-66% XVE stall with ~55-59% SBID; Q6-down reads ~1.27x/1.36x weight with ~70-74% stall and ~56-61% SBID.

LM-head is the strongest dependency/cache-pressure outlier: ALU1 utilization ~2.4-3.7%, XVE stall ~82-91%, SBID ~82-91%, and LSC hit only ~16-33%. W-C device-memory reads are ~19.15x W-S and TLB misses ~9.22x W-S; this context-conditioned amplification is descriptive from one counter probe/workload and should not be generalized without replication.
Direct occupancy remains unresolved because XVE_THREADS_OCCUPANCY_ALL returned zero for every observed dispatch; no occupancy conclusion is authorized.
Instrumented GpuTime and many L3/activity counters were all-zero and are non-informative in this COMMAND-scope provider path; M1/I003 remain the timing authority.

hypothesis_update.mechanism: ROW_SERIAL_K -> LOW_ALU_PIPE_UTILIZATION + HIGH_SCOREBOARD_DEPENDENCY_STALL; Q4_DOWN additionally shows device-memory traffic amplification.

predictions: Q4-down device_read_over_weight should fall materially from the observed 3.34x-4.40x regime toward the split-K gate/up regime (~1.02x).
Q4-down ALU1 utilization should rise materially above ~11%.
Q4-down XVE stall and SBID stall should fall materially below the current ~61-66% and ~55-59% regimes.
Component latency must improve; counter changes without latency improvement are insufficient.
Semantic output hashes/correctness must remain exact.
